text: 光譜儀本身不知道濃度。它要靠一批有參考值的樣品，建立光譜與醋酸濃度的關係。本週用第四週滴定的觀念，練習 PLS 定量；本導覽使用 NB11 模擬資料，不是實測檢驗成績。
tts: 光普儀本身不知道濃度。它要靠一批有參考值的樣品，建立光普與醋酸濃度的關係。本周用第四周滴定的觀念，練習 PLS 定量；本導覽使用 NB11 模你資料，不是實測檢驗成績。

text: 示範有十六個樣品，每個三次重裝。十二個樣品作校正，四個樣品作測試；白醋參考樣固定留在測試側。同一樣品的三條光譜，不能一部分進校正、一部分進測試。

text: PCA 找光譜自己變異最大的方向。PLS 同時使用光譜與濃度，找跟答案一起變化的潛在變數。它能處理波長多又共線的情況，但不保證加入更多潛在變數，預測就會更好。
tts: PCA 找光普自己變異最大的方向。PLS 同時使用光普與濃度，找跟答案一起變化的潛在變數。它能處理玻長多又共線的情況，但不保證加入更多潛在變數，預測就會更好。

text: 比較 raw、SNV 與 SG 一階導數時，要用相同的分組驗證。SNV 是逐條光譜標準化；PLS 的 Scale 則按波長欄位縮放。本課保留 Scale 預設開啟，而且每輪的平均與標準差只能用該輪訓練資料估計。

text: 每輪拿走一個樣品及其三次重裝，用其他十一個樣品建模，再預測被拿走的三條光譜。共輪流十二次，收集三十六個折外預測，計算 RMSECV。測試集完全不參與這個過程。
tts: 每輪拿走一個樣品及其三次重裝，用其他十一個樣品建模，再預測被拿走的三條光普。共輪流十二次，收集三十六個折外預測，記蒜 RMSECV。測試集完全不參與這個過程。

text: 增加 LV 往往讓校正誤差下降，卻可能開始配合雜訊。本資料用 SNV 時，兩個 LV 的 RMSECV 約零點四零零。這是目前資料算出的選擇，不是所有醋酸模型都應該用兩個 LV。
如果把同一樣品的重複分到訓練與驗證兩側，就不再是評估全新樣品。逐列切分可能給出偏樂觀的結果，但單一資料集不一定每次都更低。正確規則是依預期使用情境，保持樣品層級的獨立。
選好前處理、Scale 與 LV 後，先鎖定設定，再用全部校正資料建立最終模型。本示範測試 RMSEP 約零點四二七。若看過測試結果再回頭調參，這批測試集就不能再稱為未碰過的獨立驗證。
RMSE 看整體誤差量級，bias 看平均偏高或偏低，兩者不能互相取代。RPD 是測試參考值的標準差除以 RMSEP，會受測試集濃度範圍影響。四個獨立樣品太少，不能只憑 RPD 三點九一就宣稱能上產線。
參考方法的系統性偏差，會帶進校正的濃度尺度。獨立隨機誤差會增加驗證殘差的變異，但不是每次都形成不可突破的硬下限。先確認滴定品質、單次或平均參考值，以及不確定度，才解讀模型誤差。

text: 本教學校正範圍是零到十百分比重量體積濃度的醋酸水溶液。範圍內也要留意基質與儀器差異，不能直接套到另一台儀器。配製時依實驗規範，在抽風櫃戴護目鏡與手套，緩慢把酸加入水，並遠離火源。
進入互動實驗，從分組、前處理、交叉驗證到鎖定測試，逐幕預測並解釋。下載曲線、預測與模型紀錄。正式作業換成全班實測資料，報告適用範圍、六項指標與資料切分，並與其他組的儀器比較。

A spectrometer does not know concentration by itself. It learns a relationship from spectra paired with reference values. This week, connect titration to PLS regression. The tour uses NB11 simulated teaching data, not actual laboratory performance.

The demo has sixteen samples with three reloads each. Twelve samples form calibration and four form the test set. The white-vinegar reference stays in the test set. All three replicates of one sample must remain on the same side.

PCA seeks directions of variation in spectra alone. PLS uses spectra and reference concentrations to find latent variables related to the response. It handles many correlated wavelengths, but adding more latent variables does not guarantee better prediction.

Compare raw spectra, SNV, and SG derivatives using the same grouped validation. SNV standardizes each spectrum; PLS scaling standardizes variables. Here Scale is on by default. Every fold must estimate its means and standard deviations from that fold's training data only.

Leave one calibration sample and all three reloads out. Fit on the other eleven samples, then predict the held-out three spectra. Repeat twelve times to obtain thirty-six out-of-fold predictions and RMSECV. The test set does not participate.

Adding latent variables can reduce calibration error while fitting noise. For these data, SNV with two latent variables gives RMSECV around zero point four zero zero. This is a result for this dataset, not a universal prescription for acidity models.

Splitting replicates between training and validation no longer tests a genuinely new sample. Row-wise splitting can look optimistic, although it need not give a lower error on every dataset. Keep sample-level independence aligned with the intended use.

Lock preprocessing, scaling, and latent-variable count before fitting the final calibration model. The demonstration test RMSEP is about zero point four two seven. If you tune after seeing test results, that test set is no longer untouched independent validation.

RMSE measures overall error; bias measures average signed error. Neither replaces the other. RPD divides the test reference standard deviation by RMSEP and depends on the test concentration spread. Four independent samples are too few to justify production use from RPD alone.

Systematic reference bias shifts the calibration scale. Independent random reference error contributes to validation residual variance, but is not an inviolable lower bound for every observed RMSE. Check titration quality, averaging, and uncertainty before interpreting model error.

The teaching calibration covers zero to ten percent weight per volume aqueous acetic acid. Even inside that range, matrix and instrument changes matter. Do not transfer the model blindly. Follow the lab procedure: hood, goggles, gloves, slowly add acid to water, and keep away from ignition sources.

Explore the six-act lab from grouping and preprocessing to cross-validation and locked testing. Predict, operate, explain, and download curves, predictions, and the model record. For the assignment, use class measurements and report the split, applicability range, six metrics, and instrument comparison.
